purpose: Test long-horizon cross-asset momentum after repeated short-horizon bar-pattern failures. This is a separate evidence lane and does not inherit any prior candidate status.

common_calendar.signal_date: last date in each signal month on which all eight ETFs have a valid adjusted close
common_calendar.entry_date: first later date on which all eight ETFs have a valid adjusted open
common_calendar.exit_date: the entry_date associated with the next signal month
common_calendar.window_boundary_rule: The final signal month in each stage is chosen so its exit remains inside that stage's calendar block; therefore December 2019, December 2023 and December 2025 are not signal months.
common_calendar.missing_data: No interpolation, forward fill, proxy substitution or ticker substitution. A month is ineligible if any required common date or lookback observation is missing.

economics.cost_treatment: Every monthly leg pays the full frozen round-trip haircut even when its direction persists across rebalances; this deliberately overstates turnover rather than using post-result persistence to reduce costs.

CA_TS12M_SIGN_V1.signal: positive feature => long; negative feature => short; exactly zero => flat for that leg
CA_TS12M_SIGN_V1.portfolio: equal weight across all non-flat ETF legs, gross exposure normalized to 1.0; no volatility scaling

CA_XS12_1_MOM_V1.ranking: rank all eight ETFs by feature; ties broken ticker ascending
CA_XS12_1_MOM_V1.portfolio: long top two, short bottom two, equal weight across four legs, gross exposure 1.0 and net exposure 0

controls.reversed: Multiply every original leg direction by -1 using identical signal, ranking, entry and exit dates and identical costs.

gates.promotion: D0 survival only unlocks D3. D3 survival only unlocks D3b. Historical survival never establishes persistent edge or live eligibility; a survivor gets a new candidate ID and prospective future shadow after the full historical chain.
